description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-12 under road-to-account-lifecycle-threat-rows 1.1, which rewrote this skill's validation-timing guidance and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the three things the skill actually owns — validation TIMING, the error-display contract, and the submission lifecycle including double-submit — in the explicit and the symptom-first phrasing its own description names. Near-misses are three neighbours that share form vocabulary and are somebody else's job: the visual design of a form (fe-design), the server-side validation rules behind it (laravel-validation), and the accessibility audit of the same screen (accessibility-auditor), which this skill defers to rather than performs. Counterexamples guard the 'form' homonym: a Google Form and a form letter are not this skill's subject.

queries.q: should this field validate on blur or on submit?
our checkout submits twice when the user double-clicks — fix the submission lifecycle
where should the error message sit relative to the field, and how do I wire aria-describedby?
design the dirty/pristine state for this multi-step wizard so back does not lose answers
review this signup form before we ship it
wann soll dieses Feld validieren — beim Verlassen oder erst beim Absenden?
make this form look less cramped — spacing, type scale, the submit button
write the FormRequest rules for the registration endpoint
is this form usable with a screen reader?
queries.note: accessibility-auditor; this skill defers to it
